name: breastcare-ai
description: BreastCare AI — clinical decision-support and patient-management platform for breast cancer awareness, risk assessment, nutrition support, treatment tracking and blockchain-based medical data integrity.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @breastcare/shared && npm run build -w @breastcare/backend && npm run build -w @breastcare/frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w @breastcare/shared && npm run test -w @breastcare/backend && npm run test -w @breastcare/contracts
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @breastcare/shared && npm run typecheck -w @breastcare/backend && npm run typecheck -w @breastcare/frontend
